THE WRITING ON THE WALL

Babylon, the feast of King Belshazzar — a hand appeared and wrote upon the plaster, over against the lampstand.

❮ click the lampstand, then carry it to the wall — press esc to let go ❯
×

MENE, MENE, TEKEL, PARSIN

menē, menē, tēqēl, ū-parsn

Numbered, numbered, weighed, divided.
God has numbered the days of your kingdom and brought it to an end. You have been weighed on the scales and found wanting. Your kingdom is divided.

DANIEL 5 : 25–28
